messages:
Alex K: pagerduty: P1 - gpu-pool-ashb is at 100% allocated, autoscaler failed to add nodes, queue length on inference-queue up 6x, multiple customer QPS throttled. tagging eng-sre.

pagerduty-bot: AUTOMATED ALERT: autoscaler.error: 'scale_limit_reached' on pool=ashb region=us-west2 — page sent to oncall.

Maya R: seeing a bunch of MIG fragments. many hosts have leftover 1g slices and some 2g, can't co-locate new allocations. autoscaler keeps trying to provision but binpack fails due to fragmentation.

Devon S: confirmed. `kubectl get pods -o wide` shows pending pods with reason: InsufficientGPUs, and scheduler logs show repeated placement rejections: `no node matches required mig profile`.

Anisha P: customer impact: several long-tail customers reporting 5xx/timeout on generation endpoints, latency spike to 10-30s. support queue is getting noise. Jordan, can you surface the most impacted accounts?

Jordan (support): putting list in thread — customer A, B (high-SLAs), and a bunch of small accounts. I'll start sending short status notes to the affected accounts.

Alex K: steps: 1) immediate mitigation: fall back critical customers to a smaller model on CPU pool or an alternate region; 2) live mitigation: try emergency repack / force-defrag on a subset of hosts; 3) medium: increase scale_limit temporarily and coordinate cloud quota if needed. Thoughts?

Maya R: Agree on fallback for critical customers. Repack will be noisy — we should pick a non-busy AZ subset. Repacking command uses our placement tool: 
```
# dry-run first
plcctl repack --pool ashb --filter 'az:us-west2-b' --max-drain 5 --dry-run
# if looks ok
plcctl repack --pool ashb --filter 'az:us-west2-b' --max-drain 5
```
Note: repack will evict some workloads — we need canaries and tenancy-aware selection.

Devon S: autoscaler logs show it hit a configured hard cap of 240 GPUs for pool ashb. We could raise to 320 temporarily but need ops approval and verify cloud quota. Raising will likely allow new allocations while repack runs.

Anisha P: I'm ok with ordering both: trigger fallback routing for sensitive routes and request quota bump. I'll draft customer-facing blurb.

Alex K: Jordan - send an update: "We're aware of degraded performance for generation endpoints; we're rerouting traffic for critical customers and doing an emergency placement rebalance. Estimated mitigation 30-90 minutes." Keep it short.

Jordan (support): sent to impacted customers. responses include: 'thx for the update' and 1 customer asked for ETA and whether tokens were lost — clarified no data loss, just degraded response times.

sre-bot: NOTE: recent deploys increased MIG profile variance — new model launch used mixed mig configs (1g,2g) across the pool without consolidation policy. Recommend rollback of that deploy if it correlates.

Maya R: can we check deploy history? `deployctl history --since 2h --pool ashb` shows a ramped release of v2-encoder that set preferred MIG=2g but didn't enforce strict affinity, so hosts ended up with mixed slices.

Devon S: I'm initiating an emergency pack job to aggregate available slices: `plcctl emergency-pack --pool ashb --target-mig 2g --max-surge 10` — will run after dry-run approval from Alex. This should free contiguous slots for new pods.

Alex K: Approved. Run dry-run first and post results. Also I'm going to request quota bump with cloud team: opening support case now.

Devon S: dry-run completed. It predicts 48 GPUs consolidatable into 2g slots in us-west2-b with expected 6 evictions. If we proceed, there will be transient latency.

Maya R: recommend we do repack on a subset (us-west2-b) and keep us-west2-c alone as fallback. We'll route critical customers to us-west2-c CPU hosts as we run this.

Anisha P: I'm patching routing rules in the router to send customer A/B to us-west2-c (CPU) flavor and to smaller model to preserve SLA. patch: 
```
PATCH /routes/critical/customers
{ "destination": "us-west2-c:cpu-fallback", "model": "quantized-medium" }
```
Rollout will be immediate.

Jordan (support): customers A/B acknowledged. They prefer model degradation over timeouts.

sre-bot: cloud request update: quota increase approved to 320 GPUs for project redwood-prod in us-west2 (soft limit until 02:00 UTC).

Devon S: increasing pool limit now and kicking off actual emergency-pack. Running `plcctl repack --pool ashb --filter 'az:us-west2-b' --max-drain 5`

(operations logs)
Devon S: evicting pod inference-xyz (node gpu-12) -> rescheduled to gpu-21.
Devon S: migration completed for 5 pods in batch 1. Observed 500ms extra latency spikes during evict.

Maya R: After batch 2, allocator shows 32 contiguous GPUs freed and two new 2g slots available. New pods are starting up. Pending queue is dropping.

Alex K: monitor queues and latency. If we see stabilization, roll back fallback routing.

Jordan (support): update sent to customers: mitigation in progress, traffic rerouted for critical customers, expectation: gradual recovery within 45 minutes.

Anisha P: one postmortem note: need stricter deploy gating on mixed-MIG changes — enforce consolidation policy and add a preflight check on deploys that change preferred MIG sizes.

Devon S: recording logs and saving scheduler traces for postmortem. Will include `kubectl describe node` snapshots and placement diagnostics.

Maya R: handing off to night oncall: @Maya R -> @Alex K (night shift). I'm going to bed, leaving runbook: watch queue length, if pending > 200 for > 5m, escalate to infra-leads.

Alex K: received, taking over monitoring. Final status at handoff: queue length down from 6x to 1.2x, latency trending toward baseline, autoscaler accepted new nodes. Leaving notes for postmortem.

sre-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: autoscale + fragmentation incident — mitigation in progress.

Devon S: follow-ups: 1) add a periodic defrag job to avoid binpack drift, 2) add an autoscaler alarm when repeated placement rejections exceed threshold, 3) improve deploy gating for MIG profile changes.

Anisha P: drafting postmortem and customer summary. Will include timeline and action items.

Jordan (support): final customer note queued: "Issue mitigated; systems recovering; we will follow up with a detailed postmortem"

Alex K: marking incident as 'mitigated' in tracker for now. will update with postmortem link when ready.

pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: manual close by Alex K.
